name: Disneyland Alien Pizza Planet Kids' Plain/Alfredo Pasta or Cheese Pizza Slice
whyItWorks: Count Down Chicken Fusilli (or the Kids' Pasta requested plain or with light cream/Parmesan sauce and grilled chicken) gives you soft refined pasta without spicy pepperonis or raw veggies.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask at the pasta counter for fusilli/spaghetti with plain grilled chicken and grated Parmesan (hold the sun-dried tomatoes and heavy garlic cream if sensitive, and take lactase).
watchOuts: Standard Count Down Chicken Fusilli contains sun-dried tomatoes and dairy cream sauce—pick out sun-dried tomatoes and take lactase
